title: Feature Request: Automatic autolinking of function names in documentation
description:
@edgararuiz hi, and thanks for your work on this!

I attempted to set up a package website using `pkgsite`, but unfortunately, I had to abandon it and revert to `pkgdown` because the lack of automatic inline autolinking was a showstopper for me.

Current Behavior: In `pkgsite`, mentioning a function like `my_function()` in README.qmd or vignettes renders as plain text. To create a link, I am forced to manually write `[my_function()](reference/my_function.qmd)` every single time or maybe come up with a lua filter or some other solution. For a package with many references, this manual overhead is prohibitive.

Desired Behavior: `pkgsite` automatically detects inline code (and, apparently, the codebase it belongs too...? Python? R?) that matches exported function names (e.g., `my_function()`) and convert them into hyperlinks to the corresponding reference page, similar to how `pkgdown` does.

I am not sure how feasible that is, but I think it would certainly be very nice to have.
